transport.reuse: chunks-1 packet and digest media endpoints; independent assessment cursor, records and receipts

identity.items: id; position and frozen semantic snapshot immutable
identity.answers: answer.id; one immutable original answer per sessionItemId
identity.corrections: id; append only, conflicting revisions for the same answer retained for resolution
identity.reports: SHA256 of canonical report JSON, independent of local display revision slot
identity.collectionLinks: sessionItemId + operationId; entryId mapped through account entity aliases

audio.paths: relativePath is empty and assetId is null on the wire; never send local paths
audio.original: media digest and format reference; bytes uploaded before packet commit
audio.system: preserve text, voice description, kind, original digest and playback facts; rebuild local cache without changing old scores

merge: Three-way append merge from acknowledged base. Immutable conflicts, competing answers or corrections retain both complete packets. Pending push stays frozen until acknowledged. Unresolved entry references remain pending without creating personal entries.
scope: One authenticated account. No complete catalog, bank drafts, model settings, credentials or unselected questions. Existing svl-sync-1 remains unchanged.
